Kaunas University of Technology, Lithuania ## Description FruQ-DB is a dataset containing 11 varieties of fruits images. These images were created from YouTube fruit time-lapse videos (see link to the videos below). The FruQ-DB database consist of image frames from fruits such as banana, cucumber, grape, kaki, papaya, peach, pear, pepper, strawberry, tomatoes, and watermelon. A total number of 5647 preprocessed images with de-watermarked and resized (224x224). Three classes of fruit quality with number of image samples per class is summarized below: 1. Fresh (2182 images) 2. Mild (1364 images) 3. Rotten  (2101 images) Another datasets is uploaded FruQ-Multi is another folder containing each types of fruits and their classes. Links to the YouTube videos for the different fruit time elapse are:  **Avocado** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeQehUXZYPk**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeQehUXZYPk) **Banana** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OmcXo9XC6Uc**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OmcXo9XC6Uc) **Cucumber** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UMnevucxOug**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UMnevucxOug) **Kaki (persimmon)** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xE0Pw7jeOBo**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xE0Pw7jeOBo) **Papaya** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M8scWymSp2Y**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M8scWymSp2Y) **Peach** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g9pf19wk0-E&t=367s**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g9pf19wk0-E&t=367s) **Pepper** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0Sd6Foaepk**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H0Sd6Foaepk) **Strawberry** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UMnevucxOug**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UMnevucxOug) **Tomato** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6xEcoU1vAZk**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6xEcoU1vAZk) **Watermelon** [**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S12zZhdOckc**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S12zZhdOckc) ## Files ### FruQ-DB.zip ### Files (4.9 GB) | Name | Size | | | --- | --- | --- | | [FruQ-DB.zip](https://zenodo.org/records/7224690/files/FruQ-DB.zip?download=1)
